index.html.title: The Pittsburgh Wire | Local Business & Service Guides
index.html.description: Read Pittsburgh business news and practical local service comparisons. Explore the business directory and check providers’ current details before booking or buying.
index.html.heading: Research a local business before you book or buy
index.html.body:
Use the Pittsburgh business directory to discover providers and local comparison guides to prepare your questions. Compare service scope, location, written estimates and booking requirements directly with the business.

News and published guides describe the information available when reported. Confirm current hours, menus, prices and availability before making a trip or purchase. Send a sourced correction if a listing or article needs an update.

news/opal-grand-buffet-waterfront-homest.title: Opal Grand Buffet Waterfront | Visit & Menu Sources
news/opal-grand-buffet-waterfront-homest.description: Research Opal Grand Buffet at Pittsburgh’s Waterfront. Check the restaurant’s official menu, hours and current details before planning a visit.
news/opal-grand-buffet-waterfront-homest.heading: Check current details before your Waterfront visit
news/opal-grand-buffet-waterfront-homest.body:
For current meal periods, menu options, pricing and hours, use Opal Grand Buffet’s official website. Confirm the day and time you intend to visit rather than assuming an older reported price still applies.

Use The Waterfront’s tenant listing for shopping-center context and verify any accessibility, group or dietary questions directly with the restaurant. This article is local reporting, not the restaurant’s booking or ordering service.
